html:
Jonker Afrikaner was the leader of the Oorlam Afrikaners, a group of Khoekhoe origin from the Cape who moved into central Namibia and dominated it from the 1830s until his death in 1861.

The Oorlam had horses, guns and Dutch ways from the Cape frontier. Jonker allied with Nama chiefs against Herero cattle owners, raided far and wide, and traded cattle south to the Cape for guns and goods.

In about 1840 he settled at the hot springs of Windhoek, now the capital of Namibia, and had a road built to the coast. His raids made him feared, and after his death the Herero broke Oorlam power. Leaders such as Hendrik Witbooi came from the same Oorlam world, before German rule.
